title.vi: Đánh giá phân loại và cross-validation

summary.vi: confusion matrix, precision, recall, F1, ROC-AUC, k-fold
summary.en: confusion matrix, precision, recall, F1, ROC-AUC, k-fold

files.name: main.py
files.code:
import numpy as np
from sklearn.metrics import (confusion_matrix, precision_score, recall_score,
                             f1_score, accuracy_score)

y_true = np.array([1, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1])
y_pred = np.array([1, 0, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 1])

tn, fp, fn, tp = confusion_matrix(y_true, y_pred).ravel()
print(tp, fp, fn, tn)
print("precision", precision_score(y_true, y_pred))
print("recall   ", recall_score(y_true, y_pred))
print("f1       ", f1_score(y_true, y_pred))

from sklearn.datasets import load_iris
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.model_selection import cross_val_score
X, y = load_iris(return_X_y=True)
scores = cross_val_score(LogisticRegression(max_iter=500), X, y, cv=5)
print(scores.round(3), scores.mean().round(3))

import numpy as np

y_true = np.array([1, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1])
y_pred = np.array([1, 0, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 1])
tp = int(np.sum((y_true == 1) & (y_pred == 1)))
fp = int(np.sum((y_true == 0) & (y_pred == 1)))
fn = int(np.sum((y_true == 1) & (y_pred == 0)))
tn = int(np.sum((y_true == 0) & (y_pred == 0)))
print(tp, fp, fn, tn)

solution.name: main.py
solution.code:
from sklearn.datasets import load_iris
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.model_selection import cross_val_score

X, y = load_iris(return_X_y=True)
model = LogisticRegression(max_iter=500)
cv_scores = cross_val_score(model, X, y, cv=5)
cv_mean = cv_scores.mean()
print(cv_scores.round(3), round(cv_mean, 3))
